section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch13 — Types of Validity (Complete)
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A newly designed short screening test for reading difficulty is administered to students, and its scores are compared, in the same week, with an already-established, lengthier diagnostic reading test. This comparison establishes:
explanation: Concurrent validity is established by correlating a new test's scores with an already-validated measure taken around the SAME time — distinct from predictive validity, which correlates with a FUTURE outcome.
